title: Houzz Pros Scraper input

category.title: Professional category
category.description: The Houzz professional type to search, e.g. 'general contractor', 'interior designer', 'kitchen and bathroom remodeler', 'architect', 'landscape architect'. Free text — slugified automatically to the Houzz directory. Leave blank only if you pass startUrls instead.

location.title: Location
location.description: City and state/region to filter professionals, e.g. 'New York, NY' or 'Austin, TX'. Encoded to Houzz's 'City--ST' URL form automatically. Leave blank for a nationwide search. Ignored when startUrls are supplied.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (advanced)
startUrls.description: Optional list of exact Houzz URLs to scrape directly: professional directory listings (/professionals/...) or individual pro profiles (/professionals/...-pfvwus-pf~ID). When provided, these override category/location. Accepts plain strings or {"url": "..."} objects.

enrichDetails.title: Enrich from profile pages
enrichDetails.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichDetails.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on the number of professionals pushed (and charged) in one run. Range 1-2000, default 50. The run stops and never charges beyond this number. Use a small value first to preview output and cost.

proxyCountry.title: Restricted access control
proxyCountry.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Range 1-15. Higher values raise reliability but also compute cost on hard blocks. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
